author: Tarkeshwar Narayan Sharma
name: Depth Recurrence + int4 QAT + Eval-Time Optimization
blurb: 3 unique layers x 4 recurrences = 12 effective layers at dim=768 with int4 QAT, NTK-aware RoPE eval context extension, and test-time training on validation data. SP-1024 tokenizer, 10-min 8xH100 training.
